ORDINANCE XIV OF 1977
ORDINANCE
XIV OF 1977
WEST PAKISTAN LAND REVENUE (BALUCHISTAN
SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
An
Ordinance to further amend the Baluchistan Land Revenue Act, 1967, in its
application to the Province of Baluchistan.
No. Legis
1-47/Law/71. Vol III.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Baluchistan on the 8th
November, 1977 is hereby published for general information.
1. Short tile, extent and commencement.--(1)
This Ordinance may be called the West Pakistan Land Revenue (Baluchistan Second
Amendment) Ordinances 1971.
(2) It extends
to the whole of the Province of Baluchistan except Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall
come into form at once.

XIV OF 1977
WEST PAKISTAN LAND REVENUE (BALUCHISTAN
SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
An
Ordinance to further amend the Baluchistan Land Revenue Act, 1967, in its
application to the Province of Baluchistan.
No. Legis
1-47/Law/71. Vol III.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Baluchistan on the 8th
November, 1977 is hereby published for general information.
2.
Amendment of sections 70(i) (b), Act (No. XVII of 1967).-In the Baluchistan
Land Revenue Act, 1967 (Act No. XVII of 1967) after clause (b) of subsection
(1) of section 70 the following proviso shall be added :-
Provided
that nothing herein will prevent the Revenue Officer from making special
assessment with retrospective effect.
